blocks.text: 嘿~因攏講我有病
blocks.spelling: heh～in lóng kóng guá ū pēnn

blocks.text: 一直走 翻山過嶺來到這
blocks.spelling: it-ti̍t kiânn huan-suann kuè niá lâi kàu tsiah

blocks.text: 站抵這 不怕風吹雨淋
blocks.spelling: khiā tí tsiah m̄-kiann hong-tshue hōo lâm

blocks.text: 嘿~安怎無魂有體 到嘎搭看沒你是抵對
blocks.spelling: heh～an-tsuánn bô hûn ū thé kàu kā tah khuànn bô lí sī tì-túe

blocks.text: 因叫我跪落地 雙手要綁作伙
blocks.spelling: in kiò guá kuī lo̍k-tē siang-tshiú beh pa̍k tsò-hué

blocks.text: 賣嘎我帶去哪 叫我自己稍控制
blocks.spelling: bē kā guá tuà khì túe kiò guá ka-tī sió khòng-tsè

blocks.text: 因說我有問題 尚好是賣出現
blocks.spelling: in kóng guá ū būn-tê siōng hó sī mài tshut-hiān

blocks.text: 賣溝對自己講話 生活總是要過
